title: Place value
info: Each digit in a number has a place. In 482, the 4 means 4 hundreds, the 8 means 8 tens, and the 2 means 2 ones.
Moving a digit one place to the left makes it worth ten times as much.

questions.q: In 482, the 4 is in which place?
What is the value of the 7 in 175?
questions.explain: The 7 is in the tens place, so it is worth 70.

questions.q: Which number has a 5 in the hundreds place?
Type the digit in the tens place of 64.
